title: Melbourne Medical Deputising Service Pty Ltd - proposed merger with Australian Locum Medical Service Pty Ltd
acquirers: Melbourne Medical Deputising Service Pty Ltd
targets: Australian Locum Medical Service Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced its review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
ACCC requested further information from the merger parties. ACCC timeline suspended.
The ACCC was informed that the merger parties no longer wished to proceed with the proposed merger. As a consequence, the ACCC ceased its review of this matter.
